details.description: GLM-5.2 is Z.ai's Mixture-of-Experts language model for coding-agent workloads, released June 16, 2026, with a 1,048,576-token context window and multi-effort reasoning built for large-scale implementation, automated research, performance optimization and complex debugging. This id serves GLM-5.2 through Fireworks AI's 'Fast' serverless mode, which targets 100+ tokens per second of generated throughput using the same underlying model and quality as standard serverless (Fireworks AI docs). Fireworks is retiring serverless access to GLM-5.2, including this Fast-mode endpoint, starting September 25, 2026 and recommends migrating to Z.ai's newer GLM-5.3.
advantages: The underlying GLM-5.2 model scores 81.0 on Terminal-Bench 2.1, close to Claude Opus 4.8's 85.0 (Z.ai docs).
The underlying GLM-5.2 model scores 62.1 on SWE-bench Pro (Z.ai docs).
Fireworks' Fast mode targets 100+ tokens per second of generated throughput while keeping the same underlying model and quality as standard serverless (Fireworks AI docs).
Supports a 1,048,576-token context window for large-scale codebase and agentic coding work (Fireworks AI).
disadvantages: Fireworks AI is deprecating serverless access to GLM-5.2, including this router, starting September 25, 2026, and recommends migrating to GLM-5.3 (Fireworks AI).
Text-only input and output, with no image, audio or video support (Fireworks AI).
Superseded by Z.ai's GLM-5.3, released August 18, 2026 with a reported 50% improvement over GLM-5.2 on Z.ai's internal coding benchmark (Z.ai docs).
use_cases: Large-scale code implementation and refactoring across big codebases
Automated research and long-horizon agentic coding workflows
Terminal automation and MCP-based tool-calling agents

sources.title: Fast and Priority serverless modes - Fireworks AI Docs

notes: This id (accounts/fireworks/routers/glm-5p2-fast) is documented on Fireworks' Serverless Modes page as the 'Fast' tier for GLM-5.2: the same underlying model and quality as standard serverless, targeting 100+ tokens/second throughput. No benchmark scores are published for this exact endpoint, so evaluations are left empty. Fireworks' own glm-5p2 model page states it is deprecating serverless access to GLM-5.2 starting September 25, 2026, matching the catalog's deprecation_date, and recommends migrating to GLM-5.3.
